map.推荐入睡：21:45（6 周期 9h）、23:15（5 周期 7.5h）；可接受: Recommended bedtime: 21:45 (6 cycles, 9 h) and 23:15 (5 cycles, 7.5 h); acceptable 00:45 (4 cycles, 6 h); insufficient 02:15 (3 cycles, 4.5 h). All counted back from the wake time in 90 minute…
map.按起床时间反推入睡：输入目标起床时间，工具以 90 分钟为一个睡眠周期、并预留约: Count back from wake time: enter the target wake time and the tool, using 90-minute sleep cycles plus about 15 minutes of sleep latency, works back several acceptable bedtimes.
map.优先推荐完整周期数：5 个周期(7.5h)、6 个周期(9h)为推荐区间；4 个: Complete cycles come first: 5 cycles (7.5 h) and 6 cycles (9 h) are the recommended range; 4 cycles (6 h) is on the short side and 3 cycles (4.5 h) insufficient, and these are flagged as such.
map.减少醒后困倦：在周期末尾（浅睡期）醒来比在深睡期被叫醒更清醒，按周期安排作息可减: Less grogginess after waking: waking at the end of a cycle (light sleep) leaves you more alert than being woken from deep sleep, so aligning your schedule with cycles reduces sleep inertia.
map.算例：07:00 起床、入睡潜伏期 15 分钟: Example: wake at 07:00 with a 15 minute sleep latency
map.偶尔 6 小时可行，长期不足会累积睡眠债务，影响注意力与代谢: Occasional 6-hour nights are fine, but chronic shortfall accumulates sleep debt and affects attention and metabolism
map.成人睡眠由浅睡-深睡-REM 循环组成，每轮约 90 分钟。在周期切换的浅睡点醒: Adult sleep consists of light sleep, deep sleep, and REM cycles of about 90 minutes each. Waking at a light-sleep transition makes it easiest to feel awake; this is an average and individuals vary.
map.一定要睡满 7.5 小时吗？: Do I Have to Sleep a Full 7.5 Hours?
map.多数成人 7-9 小时较合适，关键是规律与完整周期。偶尔 6 小时可行，长期不足: For most adults 7–9 hours suits them, and the key is regularity and complete cycles. Occasional 6-hour nights are fine, but chronic shortfall accumulates sleep debt and affects attention and metabolism.
